brief:
Northline is releasing the Ridge 2 trail running shoe on August 21. It's 30% lighter than the original Ridge, with a new rock plate and a recycled mesh upper.

Goal: get existing Ridge runners to upgrade and win over road runners who are trying trails.

Key message: lighter on the climb, steady on the way down.

Offer: free returns for 60 days, even if they're muddy. Must include "Free 60-day returns."

Tone: energetic, outdoorsy, plainspoken.

Need Instagram feed and Story ads, plus a banner for the running-store partner sites.

directions.name: Lighter On The Climb
directions.hook: A dawn climb on a steep rocky switchback shows the weight savings and the grip of the new rock plate, so Ridge owners can feel the upgrade.
directions.headline: 30% lighter on the climb.
directions.sub: Ridge 2 stays steady on the way down. Free 60-day returns, even muddy.
directions.imagePrompt: Low-angle photoreal action shot of a trail runner mid-stride climbing a steep rocky switchback at dawn, focus on the Northline Ridge 2 trail shoe: lightweight recycled mesh upper in off-white #eeeded with deep navy #1f2e4c overlays and burnt orange #EE5A2C accents, visible rock plate in the sole, dust kicked up from the stride. Cool navy pre-dawn sky fills the upper third as calm, empty negative space, with a thin amber #FF9022 glow on the horizon and warm rim light on the shoe. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, crisp motion, energetic and outdoorsy mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
modelPlan: flux-2-pro makes a photoreal climb scene with accurate shoe detail and clean sky for the copy.
nano-banana-2/edit recomposes the chosen master to 9:16 and 16:9 so the scene stays consistent.
Two candidates; Claude scores brand fit and copy-space clarity, then picks the stronger one.

directions.name: Mud Is Welcome
directions.hook: A close-up of a freshly muddied Ridge 2 on a clean backdrop makes the free-returns offer the reason to try it, with no risk for road runners new to trails.
directions.headline: Take it muddy. Return it free.
directions.sub: Try Ridge 2 for 60 days. Free returns, even if they're muddy.
directions.imagePrompt: Photoreal close-up product shot of a single Northline Ridge 2 trail running shoe, splashed with fresh mud, standing on a flat slab of pale granite. The upper is recycled mesh in deep navy #1f2e4c with burnt orange #EE5A2C and amber #FF9022 accents, and the rugged lugged outsole with its rock plate edge is visible. Soft overcast daylight, a few fern leaves and water droplets at the edges. Background is a smooth blurred off-white #eeeded mist, kept calm and empty across the lower third for copy. 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, tactile, honest, upbeat mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
modelPlan: flux-2-pro renders believable mud, mesh and lug texture with a clean pale lower third.
nano-banana-2/edit extends the same shoe and slab into 9:16 and 16:9 without changing the product.
Two candidates; Claude checks palette fit and texture realism, then picks the better one.

directions.name: Road To Ridge
directions.hook: One continuous path turns from asphalt to dirt, with a runner crossing the line, to speak to road runners trying trails.
directions.headline: Road legs. Trail ready.
directions.sub: Ridge 2 is 30% lighter, with a new rock plate. Free 60-day returns.
directions.imagePrompt: Photoreal wide shot of a runner seen from behind, caught mid-stride at the point where a paved road becomes a dirt forest trail. The Northline Ridge 2 shoe is in sharp focus, with a navy #1f2e4c mesh upper and burnt orange #EE5A2C details. Asphalt in the upper foreground, packed earth and pine roots in the lower foreground. A band of deep navy morning mist drifts across the middle of the frame, calm and empty for copy, lit by a small amber #FF9022 sunrise glow through the trees. 35mm lens, cinematic depth, fresh, energetic mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
modelPlan: flux-2-pro builds the road-to-trail scene with a clear mist band for center copy.
nano-banana-2/edit recomposes to 9:16 and 16:9, keeping the path, runner and mist band consistent.
Two candidates; Claude scores brand fit and band readability, then picks one.
directions.note: Keep the content copy to a minimum. Use more product photography and graphic elements rather than text. Use bold CTA.

scores.why: On-palette shoe, believable twilight light, dust adds energy, dark sky suits light type.
Hard flat navy block cuts off the torso; looks like a rendering error.

issues.label: Tight copy zone
issues.msg: The runner's head and shoulders rise into the upper third, leaving only a thin clean band for the headline.
issues.fix: Extend the dark gradient sky upward and scale the runner down slightly so the top third is clear, uninterrupted sky with no figure overlap.

issues.label: Rock plate unseen
issues.msg: The shoe looks good, but the image doesn't clearly show the rock plate or the weight savings that the hook promises, so the headline has to carry that.

issues.label: Dusk or dawn
issues.msg: The sky reads as dusk or dawn, and the dark mood is less 'upbeat trail buddy' than the brand voice suggests.

scores.why: Pleasant palette match, but shoe is a wide shot, not close-up; ferns clutter edges.
True close-up, mud and droplets believable, strong brand colors; clean light backdrop.

issues.label: Tight bottom space
issues.msg: The stone slab and shoe sole take up much of the lower third, leaving little calm space for dark headline type.
issues.fix: Extend the plain off-white backdrop downward and shift the shoe and stone slightly up so the bottom third is empty, smooth and light.

issues.label: Stray fern edges
issues.msg: Small fern fragments at the left and right edges look cropped and add visual noise near the copy zone.
issues.fix: Remove the fern fragments at the left and right edges, or keep only a single small fern leaf clear of the bottom third.

issues.label: Model naming
issues.msg: The sidewall reads 'NORTHLINE RIDGE 2' and 'ROCK PLATE', which is useful product detail, but confirm it matches the real shoe's branding and features.

issues.label: Cropped toe
issues.msg: The shoe is cropped at the right and top edges, which feels intimate but hides most of the silhouette that road runners may want to see.

scores.why: Strong forest glow and on-palette shoes, but a hard-edged navy slab cuts through the scene.
Believable haze and light, on-palette navy and orange gear, clear road-to-dirt crossing.

issues.label: Trailing foot
issues.msg: The back foot is small, tucked and partly hidden behind the front shoe, so the stride reads awkwardly.
issues.fix: Redraw the runner's rear foot so it is clearly visible, mid-stride, in proportion with the front shoe, with matching navy and orange colors.

issues.label: Hands on hips
issues.msg: The hands-on-hips pose reads as a runner pausing to catch their breath rather than moving forward, which undercuts the upbeat trail-buddy energy.

issues.label: Legs in headline band
issues.msg: The runner's shorts and legs sit in the center band where the headline goes, so light type will have to cross skin and fabric unless it is placed or scaled carefully.

issues.label: Weak surface line
issues.msg: The asphalt-to-dirt edge is soft and the yellow centerline is faint, so the 'one continuous path' idea is not clear at a glance.
issues.fix: Make the boundary where asphalt meets dirt a little crisper and more continuous across the frame, and strengthen the faint yellow centerline, without changing the runner.
